title: Teluni Human Actions
html:
Project plan · Project derivation · Secrets policy

Purpose and current state

This checklist records Teluni's prerequisites that require a project-owner decision, a human-controlled account action, an unavailable privilege, or securely supplied external configuration. Every contributor or coding agent performing implementation work must maintain it and must never silently skip work because human intervention is needed.

Teluni (https://github.com/GabriellMDias/teluni) was initialized from Orion (https://github.com/GabriellMDias/Orion). Repository settings verified for Orion—Renovate, branch protection, and security controls—do not apply to this repository; the actions below establish them here. Conditional needs such as an identity provider, durable releases, or a deployment environment become new actions when their trigger occurs.

Maintaining this checklist

  1. Inspect existing decisions, access, tools, configuration, and prior authorization before requesting human intervention. Complete authorized automation and all useful preparation first.
  2. Keep one stable PH-NN ID per coherent action; never reuse or renumber IDs. Split broad items into independently verifiable actions as they become concrete, and add newly discovered actions immediately.
  3. Every action retains its ID, checkbox, owner, status, dependency, and evidence. Active or conditional requests also need the exact action, reason, non-secret configuration names, and verification method. Use pending, in progress, completed, blocked, or changed consistently with the plan.
  4. Before asking the user, provide a concrete request: the exact setting or decision, prepared options where appropriate, why automation cannot finish it, affected task IDs, and how completion will be checked.
  5. If an action blocks work now, mark the dependent plan task blocked, link this entry, and surface the request to the user. Continue independent authorized work.
  6. Use [x] and completed only after verification, recording safe evidence and the verification date. If direct verification is unavailable, record the limitation rather than claiming success.
  7. Reopen an action with [ ] if later evidence invalidates completion, access expires, or configuration changes, and record why.
  8. A conditional item that becomes unnecessary remains [ ] with status changed, an explicit reason, and its future trigger or replacement.

Safe configuration handoff

  • Record configuration names, required scopes, environment, purpose, non-secret resource identifiers, and secure destination. Never record passwords, tokens, API keys, connection strings containing credentials, private keys, or complete environment dumps here, in the plan, in chat, or in tracked example files.
  • Name only implemented configuration keys and link the generated configuration reference; do not invent variable names in advance.
  • Humans place secrets directly into the selected protected secret store or an explicitly documented ignored local file. Contributors verify presence and authorized behavior without printing secret contents.
  • Use synthetic local and test data and ephemeral credentials where possible. Production secrets must not be prerequisites for ordinary development or CI.

PH-01

  • [x] Create Teluni's repository and publish the initialized default branch.

Status: completed. Owner: project owner or repository administrator. Dependency / trigger: PJ-01; required before this repository has its own pull requests, CI runs, or settings. Request and reason: Create an empty repository at https://github.com/GabriellMDias/teluni without a generated README, license, or ignore file, then run git push -u origin main. Initialization configured origin locally but never creates remote repositories or pushes. Configuration: none. Do not embed credentials in remote URLs. Verification: git ls-remote origin main returns the local main commit, and pnpm orion:check passes in a fresh clone. Evidence / blocker: 2026-10-17: the owner supplied successful fresh-clone output for pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (pnpm 11.25.0) and pnpm orion:check, confirming the recorded Orion baseline and @teluni scope. Independently verified that git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main and local git rev-parse refs/heads/main both return c9193734d5f5de22883af433d48006805fb86604. Repository creation/publication and fresh-clone provenance verification are complete. Remote CI and branch protection remain separate PH-02 / PJ-01 obligations.

PH-02

  • [x] Require pull requests and the CI gate on this repository's default branch, and keep merge commits available.

Status: completed. Owner: repository administrator. Dependency / trigger: PH-01; PJ-01. Request and reason: Protect main: require pull requests and the Orion required gate status check, block force pushes and deletion, and review bypass actors. Keep merge commits allowed and do not require linear history on main, because Orion upgrade pull requests must be merged with a merge commit to preserve upstream ancestry (upgrade workflow). Branch protection is repository administration that local automation cannot perform. Configuration: none beyond the repository ruleset and merge settings. Verification: Read the effective rules for main and confirm the required check name matches CI and that no linear-history requirement applies; confirm merge commits are allowed; a successful required-gate run appears on a pull request. Evidence / blocker: 2026-10-17: verified through the GitHub API that active ruleset 25323352, Protect main targets the default branch main, requires pull requests and the Orion required gate check from GitHub Actions (integration 15368), blocks deletion and non-fast-forward updates, has no bypass actors, and does not require linear history. Merge commits are allowed in both the repository settings and the ruleset. CI run 39077703462 succeeded for push commit c9193734d5f5de22883af433d48006805fb86604, including Validate and Orion required gate. PR #2 then exercised the pull-request workflow: run 39078757654 passed Validate and Orion required gate for head commit 98a87a896fce6126566ba1521c8954b1fdb5866a. Configuration and successful PR-gate verification are complete. No repository settings were changed during verification.

PH-03

  • [x] Enable Renovate for this repository.

Status: completed. Owner: repository administrator. Dependency / trigger: PH-01. Request and reason: Grant the Renovate GitHub App access to https://github.com/GabriellMDias/teluni so the committed configuration runs. App installation is an account action. Configuration: none; no personal token is required. Verification: Renovate opens this repository's Dependency Dashboard reflecting the committed dependencies and schedule. Evidence / blocker: 2026-10-17: owner confirmed installation; GitHub API verified Dependency Dashboard #1, authored by app/renovate, with detected workspace dependencies, updates awaiting the configured schedule, and major updates pending approval. These match renovate.json (weekly schedule, dashboard/major approval, automerge disabled).

PH-04

  • [x] Enable and verify applicable GitHub security controls.

Status: completed. Owner: repository administrator. Dependency / trigger: PH-01. Request and reason: Enable available code scanning, secret scanning and push protection, dependency graph, and vulnerability alerts, and set the Actions variable DEPENDENCY_REVIEW_ENABLED=true so the dependency-review job runs. Record entitlement limits for this repository's visibility and plan. Configuration: Actions variable DEPENDENCY_REVIEW_ENABLED (non-secret). Verification: Inspect effective security settings and a pull-request run in which dependency review executed and the aggregate gate passed. Evidence / blocker: 2026-10-17: owner confirmed setup. GitHub API verified this public repository has secret scanning and push protection enabled, vulnerability alerts enabled (HTTP 204), an available dependency graph/SBOM, CodeQL default setup configured, and Actions variable DEPENDENCY_REVIEW_ENABLED=true. CodeQL run 39079537512 passed analysis for Actions and JavaScript/TypeScript. Earlier PR runs skipped dependency review before the variable was set. PR #3 run 39080134706 passed Validate, Dependency review and Orion required gate for head e92673af60fe99d23023aaedccfde004a6984c16, completing the required PR verification. The existing high-severity Dependabot alert #1 for source-map-js remains open and is separately tracked as PJ-18; enabled controls do not imply a vulnerability-free dependency tree. Dependabot automatic security-update PRs are disabled; they are not an acceptance requirement and do not replace Renovate.

PH-05

  • [x] Define the product scope and acceptance criteria.

Status: completed. Owner: project owner. Dependency / trigger: PJ-02; required before product modules are implemented. Request and reason: Supply the initial product brief rather than allowing agents to invent product requirements. Configuration: none. Verification: Requirements are recorded in the repository and linked from the project plan. Evidence / blocker: 2026-10-17: owner supplied the Teluni brief covering vision, actors, MVP, offline behavior, technologies, infrastructure, business hypotheses and internationalization. Recorded in product documentation, MVP acceptance and security/data inventory. Quantitative targets and ambiguous product policies remain separate PH-09; no implemented feature is claimed.

PH-06

  • [x] Determine the product license before distribution requires it.

Status: completed. Owner: project owner, with legal input when needed. Dependency / trigger: Publication or distribution of Teluni. Request and reason: Record the owner's explicit Apache-2.0 selection for Teluni source and documentation. Inherited Orion rights remain intact; commercial SaaS terms remain PH-12. Named copyright/NOTICE attribution, if required for distribution, is separately tracked in PH-14 rather than invented. Configuration: none. Verification: License files, the README, and publication metadata match the recorded decision. Evidence / blocker: 2026-10-17: owner explicitly selected Apache-2.0. ADR-0022, the root README and all four workspace package.json license fields record that selection. The existing canonical root LICENSE already contains Apache License 2.0 and is retained unmodified. No named copyright holder or fabricated NOTICE is added.

PH-07

  • [ ] Verify the intended Teluni name, domains and visual identity before public launch.

Status: pending. Owner: project owner, with specialist input where needed. Dependency / trigger: PJ-04 and PJ-14; before external brand commitments. Request and reason: Confirm trademark/domain viability and ownership, then provide/approve the visual identity. The intended name and slogans are recorded in product vision; they are not registration or availability evidence. Configuration: none; do not publish registrar credentials. Verification: Record dated non-secret ownership/clearance evidence and approved identity assets; later verify the web/player use them. Evidence / blocker: No availability/registration or final assets verified. Does not block the documentation stage.

PH-08

  • [ ] Confirm the pilot participant, physical devices and supported hardware envelope.

Status: pending. Owner: project owner and candidate pilot operator. Dependency / trigger: PJ-07, PJ-08, PJ-09, PJ-12 and PJ-14; before hardware-specific commitments and pilot acceptance. Request and reason: Confirm the snack bar's participation and core workflow, screen/device quantity and models, Android versions, connection/storage conditions, orientations and installation/update access. A candidate customer is not a confirmed pilot or a tested hardware profile. Configuration: none yet; record model/capability facts without private access details. Verification: Approved hardware/support matrix and operator workflow, available test devices, and recorded playback/reboot/codec tests during implementation. Evidence / blocker: Owner identified a potential snack bar pilot; hardware, participation and capacity remain unverified.

PH-09

  • [ ] Agree MVP policy boundaries and measurable acceptance targets.

Status: pending. Owner: product owner with engineering input. Dependency / trigger: PJ-07 and the dependent Phase 2 slices; before claiming FR/NF acceptance or real pilot readiness. Request and reason: Review the proposed MVP policies: direct device assignment versus groups, schedule conflict/default/expiry behavior, duration rules, deletion/reference retention and safe unlink/offline revocation. Set the offline duration/clock limits, storage reserve, upload/media bounds, boot/recovery expectations, fleet/concurrency and usability targets with hardware evidence. These tradeoffs affect visible commercial content and cannot be selected from a generic engineering foundation. Configuration: none; future defaults/limits must be defined with canonical schemas when implemented. Verification: Record decisions and numeric acceptance targets in their owning specifications, with tests mapped to FR/NF IDs and review of dependent ADRs. Evidence / blocker: Candidate choices are prepared in MVP/playback docs; no numeric reliability/capacity guarantee is approved. Documentation work can finish independently.

PH-10

  • [ ] Confirm residential-host feasibility, exposure and recovery commitments before a real pilot.

Status: pending. Owner: project owner / server and network administrator. Dependency / trigger: PJ-07/PJ-13 and before PJ-14 real-customer operation. Request and reason: Supply the host/network inventory, public access/CGNAT/ISP constraints, controlled domain/HTTPS path, safe administration, power/uplink/capacity facts, off-host backup destination, recovery-key handling and acceptable RPO/RTO/downtime/support. Review the deployment readiness gates. No tunnel, free DNS or home-server arrangement has been certified suitable. Configuration: only currently implemented names from the configuration reference; new deployment keys are pending design. Put secrets only in an approved protected destination. Verification: Network/ingress/security inspection and isolated timed PostgreSQL-plus-media restore, followed by reboot/offline and endpoint-migration rehearsal with supported players. Evidence / blocker: No cloud budget; personal residential server intended. Topology, exposure, backup destination and availability/recovery targets remain unverified. No deployment authorized by this entry.

PH-11

  • [ ] Choose the human identity provider and approve the initial permission/recovery policy.

Status: pending. Owner: product owner with engineering/security review. Dependency / trigger: PJ-07/PJ-03; authentication is a stated MVP requirement. Request and reason: Evaluate established identity solutions compatible with accepted ADR-0012 against budget, enrollment, recovery, session/refresh/revocation, administration and portability. Approve the proposed actor scope and how company administrators are established. Do not invent a proprietary auth or crypto system. Configuration: existing issuer/audience/JWKS settings are documented in the API configuration reference; provider-specific secrets and destinations are not yet selected. Verification: Proposed provider ADR reviewed/accepted, attributable enrollment and allowed/denied role cases specified, then token/session/revocation tests in implementation. Evidence / blocker: Foundation JWT verification exists; no provider or product session/membership implementation selected. A future prerequisite, not a blocker to completing documentation.

PH-12

  • [ ] Validate pilot commercial terms, costs and eventual plans before offering subscriptions.

Status: pending. Owner: project owner. Dependency / trigger: PJ-14 pilot terms; PJ-16 commercial expansion. Request and reason: Validate per-screen/company pricing, storage/traffic/processing limits, support, installation, cancellation, operating cost and partnerships/referrals. BRL 79.90/month for two screens is exploratory only. Automatic billing remains outside the mandatory MVP. Configuration: none; no plan IDs, prices, gateway or entitlements implemented. Verification: Record approved pilot terms and measured cost/support evidence; later approve plan limits and commercial policies before implementing subscription enforcement. Evidence / blocker: Recurring SaaS is intended; no definitive pricing or paid infrastructure/provider budget established.

PH-13

  • [ ] Define customer data responsibilities and privacy/retention obligations before collecting pilot data.

Status: pending. Owner: project owner with qualified legal/privacy input when needed. Dependency / trigger: PJ-13/PJ-14 before real customer/personal data; international expansion when triggered. Request and reason: Review the initial data inventory, intended content restrictions, notices/terms, customer/operator responsibilities, lawful purposes, retention/deletion/export, backup reconciliation and incident contact. Determine applicable LGPD and other jurisdictional obligations against actual operation; the product documentation is not compliance certification. Configuration: no legal/privacy settings implemented; do not put customer records or private advice in public examples. Verification: Approved obligations and retention/deletion/access procedures linked to implementation and restore acceptance; no sensitive clinic/patient dataset required for signage. Evidence / blocker: Initial classifications documented; legal/operational policies and retention periods remain pending.

PH-14

  • [ ] Confirm named copyright and attribution notices when distribution requires them.

Status: pending (conditional). Owner: project owner, with qualified input where needed. Dependency / trigger: PH-06; before adding holder-specific notices or distributing artifacts with attribution requirements beyond the current repository license/provenance. Request and reason: Confirm the exact attribution names and any applicable third-party notices from evidence. Apache-2.0 is selected, but agents must not infer legal ownership from a GitHub account or invent a NOTICE. This preserves the attribution portion of the original PH-06 scope without blocking the owner's license choice. Configuration: none. Verification: Any added notices identify confirmed holders and preserve applicable inherited/third-party notices; distribution metadata matches the owner-approved attribution. Evidence / blocker: No holder-specific notice supplied or added in this task. Root LICENSE and Orion provenance remain intact.

New action template

Allocate a new stable PH-NN; do not reuse existing IDs. Link it from the blocked or conditional plan task.

## PH-NN

- [ ] **Concrete human action.**

**Status:** pending. **Owner:** actual person or responsible role.
**Dependency / trigger:** Linked task; whether it blocks current work.
**Request and reason:** Exact need, completed preparation, and why authorized automation cannot finish it.
**Configuration:** Exact non-secret names, minimum scopes and secure destination; never secret values. Use "none" if no configuration is needed.
**Verification:** Observable checks required before completion.
**Evidence / blocker:** Dated safe evidence, outstanding limit, or changed applicability.
